sloka: च्अतिथी परमौ प्राप्तम् पुत्रौ दशरथस्य तौ ।पूजयामास विधिवत् सत्कार अर्हौ महाबलौ ॥१-४८-९॥
transliteration: catithī paramau prāptam putrau daśarathasya tau ।pūjayāmāsa vidhivat satkāra arhau mahābalau ॥1-48-9॥

translations.english: The descendants of Raghu (Rama and Lakshmana) having received great honour from Sumati, stayed there one night and thereafter set out for Mithila.
